title: Glycerol electrooxidation reference family
reaction: C3H8O3 + n OH- -> C3 oxygenates (DHA, glyceraldehyde, glyceric acid, glycolate, formate) + n e- + n H2O
objective: Optional literature-backed family for glycerol electrooxidation as a low-overpotential biorefinery anode reaction. Candidates compare a Pt / C alkaline-anode anchor, a Au / C selectivity-tilted variant biased toward DHA / glyceric acid, and a NiOOH non-noble alkaline option (Goetz 2022 Nat. Comm. design).

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Balance current stack economics, evidence quality, route maturity, and reported product selectivity / overpotential.

cost-first.label: Cost-first
cost-first.description: Bias ranking toward catalyst and electrode cost while preserving route and evidence guardrails.

evidence-first.label: Evidence-first
evidence-first.description: Reward stronger literature support and more reproducible glycerol-oxidation routes.

candidates.title: Pt / C glycerol anode
candidates.summary: Pt / C anode used as the canonical alkaline glycerol-electrooxidation anchor, with the lowest documented overpotential among the three candidates.
decision_notes: Best fit when low onset potential matters more than full PGM avoidance.
Catalyst economics dominated by Pt loading even at 20 wt%.

pricing.note: Live Pt feed with a mild precursor / conversion markup.

Carbon support held on engineering proxy in line with other Pt / C electrocatalyst candidates. Bracketed by public references: UN Comtrade 2024 U.S. carbon-black import unit value ~$1.88/kg (~$0.85/lb rubber grade) and Fuel Cell Store Vulcan XC-72R lab retail ~$950/kg.

candidates.title: Au / C glycerol anode (selectivity)
candidates.summary: Au / C anode tilted toward C3 oxygenates (glyceric acid, glycerate) for higher-value product slates.
decision_notes: Best fit when the program target is selective C3 oxygenate production rather than total oxidation.
Au has a higher onset potential than Pt; trade overpotential for selectivity.

pricing.note: Live Au feed with a mild precursor / conversion markup.

Carbon support held on the same engineering proxy as the Pt / C anchor. Bracketed by public references: UN Comtrade 2024 U.S. carbon-black import unit value ~$1.88/kg (~$0.85/lb rubber grade) and Fuel Cell Store Vulcan XC-72R lab retail ~$950/kg.

candidates.title: NiOOH non-noble glycerol anode
candidates.summary: NiOOH-based alkaline anode for glycerol oxidation, the leading non-noble option with selective secondary-alcohol oxidation behavior.
decision_notes: Best fit when avoiding PGMs is the program goal and dihydroxyacetone / glycolate selectivity is acceptable.
Selectivity is governed by NiOOH cycling; cell design must accommodate Ni3+ regeneration.

pricing.note: Live Ni feed with a precursor / conversion markup; NiOOH active phase derives from Ni substrate oxidation.
